newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pluma started buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pluma started buy.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities Inc said it started coverage of Pluma Inc with a buy rating on Monday.
-- The activewear company went public on March 11 for $12 a share. J.P. Morgan was the lead underwriter of the offering.

-- In a research report, analyst Carol Pope said Pluma has been profitable every year since its first full year of operations in 1988. She said the company can accommodate sales growth of 40 to 50 percent through 1998.
-- She expects earnings per share to grow 28 percent in 1997 to $1.40 and 18 percent in 1998 to $1.65.
-- The company is due to release Q1 results on April 29. Pope estimates EPS at $0.10 compared with $0.01 last year.

-- "Activewear companies typically trade at 10-12 times prospective earnings. As Pluma develops a track record and meets our earnings forecast, we think the earnings multiple will expand, erasing a portion of the current discount from the peer group. We estimate the company will deliver 15 percent long-term earnings growth, which makes current valuation levels compelling," the report said.
